title: Skeleton in Mystic Swamp
description: A skeletal figure with a black skull stands in dark reflective water, holding glowing orbs in one hand and a large white lily in the other. Behind it, two armored riders on elephants wade through the water under a swirling purple vortex sky containing a crescent moon and floating flowers.
prompt: A skeletal figure with solid black skull standing in dark reflective water at night, one bony hand extended holding glowing turquoise and red orbs with light trails, the other hand holding a large white lily. In the background, two armored warriors riding elephants wade through the water. Vibrant orange poppies and purple flowers line the banks. A dramatic swirling purple and pink vortex in the sky filled with floating flowers and dark star-like shapes, with a bright yellow crescent moon. Surreal fantasy scene, highly detailed, vibrant yet dark atmosphere.
